column1: # Everyday validation tickets (ADR-052, written 2026-11-21 before the Naive Bayes corpus of Phase 4 was changed).
# Same format and labels as everyday_tickets.tsv. These tickets were never used to choose a lexicon word, a rule or a
# corpus row: they check that the fix generalises beyond the tickets it was tuned on. They are reported, and the
# benchmark only asserts that the fix does not make them worse than the original code.
